sentences.text:
Petitioner
 Bag
 Mr. A.C. Behera, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha & others .... Opp. Parties
 Mr. B.K. Ragada, Aga
 Mr. S.K. Parida, Advocate
 Coram:
 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order
 No. 12.09.2024
 02. 1.

This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
 2.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.
 3.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with  Ambabhana P.S. Case No.244 of 2022 corresponding to  C.T. Case No.61 of 2023 registered under Sections  363/376(2)(n)/366/376(3)/344/34 of the IPC read  with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court  of leaned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court  under POCSO Act, Bargarh.
 4. The prosecution case is that the grand daughter  of the informant was kidnapped by the present  petitioner with the help of one Kuber Patikar forcefully.
They have also kept physical relationship with the victim forcefully.
Hence, the F.I.R. has been lodged.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 15.12.2023 and he is aged about 22 years.
6. The victim, who is aged about 19 years, is present in Court today along with her counsel.
She is also identified by her counsel and also filed her self attested photocopy of her Aadhar Card to establish her identity.

7. On a query from the Court, the victim states that Bhaskara Bag @ Bhaskara vs State Of Odisha & Others .... Opp. ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39360983/
1 she has already married to the petitioner and they are blessed with a son on 01.10.2023.

entities.text: Bhaskara Bag @ Bhaskara vs State Of Odisha & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. The bail plea of the petitioner was rejected on 17.05.2024 by the learned trial Court.
9. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the plea of bail of the petitioner is not pending before any other Court, except the present one.

8. Taking into consideration the period of custody since 15.12.2023, the nature of accusation and the fact that the victim has already married the petitioner and they are blessed with a son, I am inclined to admit the petitioner on bail.

The prosecution is given liberty to move application before the Court below for cancellation of bail,
if the petitioner violates any of the conditions of the bail granted to him.
9. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

(S.S. Mishra) Judge amit Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Bhaskara Bag @ Bhaskara vs State Of Odisha & Others .... Opp. ... on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39360983/
